info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Travel Expenses Retrieval API
info.description: The Travel Expenses Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information about travel expenses associated with human resource management. Leveraging this API, HR personnel can efficiently retrieve and review expenses submitted by employees, ensuring accurate financial tracking and reporting. Typical consumers include HR departments and finance teams who require transparency in employee travel expenditures. This API streamlines the process of verifying and managing travel-related costs, promoting better budget oversight and expense management.

get.summary: Retrieve travel expense details by ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the details of a specific travel expense using its unique identifier. It provides essential information related to the expense for effective management and analysis.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving travel expenses associated with a specific resource (RES-100045) in the Human Resource Management system. This request allows the caller to obtain detailed information about the travel expenses for the specified resource.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the travel expense details.

GetTravelExpenseByIdRequest.description: The request body for the Get Request concerning travel expenses operations.

GetTravelExpenseByIdResponse_200.title: Travel Expense Report Response

expenseReportId.description: Unique identifier for the expense report.

employeeId.description: Identifier for the employee associated with the expense report.

tripPurpose.description: The purpose of the trip for which the expenses are claimed.

expensePeriod.description: The period during which the expenses were incurred.

claimedAmount.description: The total amount claimed for the expenses.

costCenter.description: The cost center to which the expenses are charged.

recordStatus.description: The current status of the expense report (e.g., submitted, approved, rejected).

version.description: The version of the expense report.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the expense report was last updated.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the response.
